Patna Court Extends Arrest Protection for Khan Sir

A Patna court has extended the protection from arrest for a popular educator known as Khan Sir until June 30. The court's decision provides him with continued reprieve from potential legal action. This development pertains to ongoing legal proceedings involving the educator.
